explanation:
[EFFECT] Hour of day has a strong non-monotonic effect: the early-morning overnight hours (blue, low values) drive predicted demand steeply down — contributions reach as far left as roughly −3.5 in log space — while afternoon and evening hours (red, high values) push demand up to around +1. The exact shape of peaks within the day cannot be pinpointed from this plot, but the overall swing is by far the largest of any feature.
[IMPORTANCE] This is the single most important feature in the model, with a spread several times wider than any other — it dominates every prediction.
